H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H5104: a stream (including the sea; expectation the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, prosperity
H894: Babel (i.e. Babylon), including Babylonia and the Babylonian empire
H8033: there (transferring to time) then; often thither, or thence
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H1571: properly, assemblage; used only adverbially also, even, yea, though; often repeated as correl. both...and
H2142: properly, to mark (so as to be recognized), i.e. to remember; by implication, to mention; to be male
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H6726: Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem
H6155: a willow (from the use of osiers as wattles)
H8432: a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H7592: to inquire; by implication, to request; by extension, to demand
H1697: a word; by implication, a matter (as spoken of) or thing; adverbially, a cause
H8437: causing to howl, i.e. an oppressor
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H5236: foreign, or (concretely) a foreigner, or (abstractly) heathendom
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H7911: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of, from want of memory or attention
H3389: Jerushalaim or Jerushalem, the capital city of Palestine
H3225: the right hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the stronger and more dexterous); locally, the south
H1692: properly, to impinge, i.e. cling or adhere; figuratively, to catch by pursuit
H3956: the tongue (of man or animals), used literally (as the instrument of licking, eating, or speech), and figuratively (speech, an ingot, a fork of flame, a cove of water)
H2441: properly, the palate or inside of the mouth; hence, the mouth itself (as the organ of speech, taste and kissing)
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H5927: to ascend, intransitively (be high) or actively (mount); used in a great variety of senses, primary and secondary, literal and figurative
H7218: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H123: Edom, the elder twin-brother of Jacob; hence the region (Idumaea) occupied by him
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H6168: to be (causatively, make) bare; hence, to empty, pour out, demolish
H5704: as far (or long, or much) as, whether of space (even unto) or time (during, while, until) or degree (equally with)
H1323: a daughter (used in the same wide sense as other terms of relationship, literally and figuratively)
H7703: properly, to be burly, i.e. (figuratively) powerful (passively, impregnable); by implication, to ravage
H835: happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection, how happy!
H7999: to be safe (in mind, body or estate); figuratively, to be (causatively, make) completed; by implication, to be friendly; by extension, to reciprocate (in various applications)
H1576: treatment, i.e. an act (of good or ill); by implication, service or requital
H1580: to treat a person (well or ill), i.e. benefit or requite; by implication (of toil), to ripen, i.e. (specifically) to wean
H270: to seize (often with the accessory idea of holding in possession)
H5310: to dash to pieces, or scatter
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H5553: a craggy rock, literally or figuratively (a fortress)
